permitted_claims.statement: Numerical systems provide the strongest material continuity between pre-writing devices and proto-cuneiform.
permitted_claims.counterevidence: Continuity of individual non-numerical sign shapes is much less secure.
permitted_claims.narrative_implication: Use only with the stated confidence and boundary.

permitted_claims.statement: Neolithic clay objects called tokens were multifunctional; their existence does not prove a millennia-long standardized accounting code.
permitted_claims.counterevidence: Some late simple tokens in bullae clearly served numerical/accounting functions.
permitted_claims.narrative_implication: Use only with the stated confidence and boundary.

permitted_claims.statement: The direct token→tablet→writing sequence is too linear; seals, iconography, bullae, numerical tablets and institutional practice formed a parallel ecology.
permitted_claims.counterevidence: Exact contribution of each component cannot be quantified.
permitted_claims.narrative_implication: Use only with the stated confidence and boundary.

permitted_claims.statement: Administrative scale is a major formation pressure but not evidence that administration was the sole cause of writing.
permitted_claims.counterevidence: Preserved earliest texts are overwhelmingly administrative, but corpus survival is selective.
permitted_claims.narrative_implication: Use only with the stated confidence and boundary.

permitted_claims.statement: The evidence supports a feedback model: expanding institutions demanded records, and better records could expand institutional capacity.
permitted_claims.counterevidence: Downstream effects require WS06 case studies; WS02 cannot establish them alone.
permitted_claims.narrative_implication: Use only with the stated confidence and boundary.

permitted_claims.statement: The preserved proto-cuneiform corpus can distinguish accounting contexts more securely than it can distinguish market exchange from tax, tribute or redistribution.
permitted_claims.counterevidence: Named agents, commodities, metrology and document structure sometimes narrow the transaction, but sign readings and institutional context remain incomplete.
permitted_claims.narrative_implication: Use 'accounting/administrative transfer' unless reciprocity or institutional flow is independently demonstrated.

permitted_claims.statement: Redistribution, labor coordination, obligation and ownership are not interchangeable formation mechanisms: each requires different evidence beyond the presence of numbers and commodities.
permitted_claims.counterevidence: A single tablet may participate in more than one mechanism, and early terminology is partly reconstructed.
permitted_claims.narrative_implication: Label the mechanism only when flows, persons, quotas, duration, seals or transfer conditions support it.

permitted_claims.statement: Co-occurrence between urban institutional growth and record systems establishes pressure and compatibility, not a one-way proof that either caused the other.
permitted_claims.counterevidence: Later cases may demonstrate capacity effects, but those belong to WS06 and cannot be back-projected.
permitted_claims.narrative_implication: Present the WS02 feedback loop as a hypothesis to be tested, not as a completed causal verdict.
